prompt: Which description would be most accurate in a report about the two blank sign-up choices?
promptZh: 在報告中描述兩位志工都未勾選動物照護時，下列哪項說法最準確？

options.text: Neither volunteer wanted the work, so clearer wording would not have changed what we learned.
options.zh: 兩位志工都不想做這項工作，所以寫得更清楚也不影響我們得到的資訊。
options.whyZh: 諾亞確實不想做；米拉沒選是因為誤以為自己不符合資格，不是明確表達不想做。

options.text: Both blanks show that a beginner-friendly introduction is needed because both volunteers felt unqualified.
options.zh: 兩處空白都表示需要新手導覽，因為兩位志工都覺得自己資格不足。
options.whyZh: 米拉誤以為不能選且詢問帶領；諾亞看懂欄位，只是想做不涉及照護動物的工作。

options.text: One blank conceals possible interest, while the other reflects an informed choice to do different work.
options.zh: 一處空白可能掩蓋志工的興趣；另一處則反映志工在看懂說明後選擇做其他工作。
options.whyZh: 米拉不勾是因為誤解選擇資格，卻有詢問如何入門；諾亞是理解後表達自己的工作偏好。表單收集的是偏好，不能把兩個空白一概當成不想做。

options.text: Mila has already chosen animal-care work, while Noah still needs help understanding his options.
options.zh: 米拉已選擇動物照護工作，而諾亞還需要協助理解可選的工作。
options.whyZh: 米拉問入門方式不等於已勾選或承諾參加；諾亞已理解欄位，不是看不懂。

explanationZh: 米拉不勾是因為誤解選擇資格，卻有詢問如何入門；諾亞是理解後表達自己的工作偏好。表單收集的是偏好，不能把兩個空白一概當成不想做。

vocabulary.note: 這並不是必備資格；未勾選可能是誤會，而非確定沒興趣。

evidence: We are revising how we introduce the welcome shift to new volunteers. It combines two jobs: greeting visitors and putting completed adoption packs in the outgoing tray. The visitor queue can form again at any time. Adoption packs are different: once a pack reaches the tray, the next team takes responsibility for it. A volunteer may do either job without changing shifts. The sign-up form helps us learn what people want to do, not decide who qualifies. / Finally, I asked two people why they had not selected animal-care work on the sign-up form. Mila left it blank because she thought ‘experience helpful’ meant she was not allowed to choose it; she asked whether someone could show her how to start. Noah understood the entry but wanted work that did not involve caring for animals. Leave animal-care work voluntary, but make clear that a newcomer may select it and request an introduction.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We are revising how we introduce the welcome shift to new volunteers. It combines two jobs: greeting visitors and putting completed adoption packs in the outgoing tray. The visitor queue can form again at any time. Adoption packs are different: once a pack reaches the tray, the next team takes responsibility for it. A volunteer may do either job without changing shifts. The sign-up form helps us learn what people want to do, not decide who qualifies.

Finally, I asked two people why they had not selected animal-care work on the sign-up form. Mila left it blank because she thought ‘experience helpful’ meant she was not allowed to choose it; she asked whether someone could show her how to start. Noah understood the entry but wanted work that did not involve caring for animals. Leave animal-care work voluntary, but make clear that a newcomer may select it and request an introduction.
